links.outcome: Accuracy, clarity, relevance and tone scores of nine public AI tools on hematology questions
links.effect: Scores ranged from 19 to 67 out of 100 across tools; clinical biases and hallucinations were still observed.
links.quote: The performance of the AI tools varied significantly, with scores ranging from 19 to 67 out of 100.

links.outcome: Presence of references/citations in LLM answers to hematology questions
links.effect: Lack of references was noted as a notable limitation of the AI tools; no numeric rate reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Despite their educational potential and accessibility, these AI tools exhibit notable limitations: lack of references, out-of-context responses, and optimism or alarmist biases.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses to hematology queries graded by experts and surveys patient perceptions regarding using LLMs to interpret test results.
